title: How do you keep fit? – B1 English Listening Test

seo.title: How do you keep fit? – B1 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Boost your English listening skills with this B1 intermediate comprehension test about sport and exercise. Feedback & transcription included!

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Listen to three people talk about their experiences with fitness and exercise, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.

See the full list of B1 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: What does Rebecca think about joining a gym?

choices.html: It doesn't provide enough variety for her.

questions.prompt: What is Rebecca's advice about friends and exercise?

choices.html: Make friends with people who like exercise.
Encourage your friends to exercise with you.
Don't be embarrassed about exercising alone.
included exercise in his everyday routine.

questions.prompt: As a young man, Leo kept fit because…

choices.html: he was always worried about his health.
he was a member of various sports teams.
he had a generally active lifestyle.

questions.prompt: Leo has found that exercising with other people has…

choices.html: had little impact on his fitness level.
introduced him to several new sports.
enabled him to return to his past fitness level.
